_comment: Real Google Health API v4 shape (WP-51), from the published reference developers.google.com/health/reference/rest/v4 (fetched 2026-09-27): a reconcile response is {dataPoints:[{dataPointName, <unionKey>:{...}}], nextPageToken}, each point a typed union member with its own time field and units. dataPointName is empty for most types (the client derives a stable ID). Values carried over from the pre-WP-51 fixture and converted to wire units. Still doc-derived: confirm against a real response. Sessions are identifiable, so dataPointName is set here.
